thought.text: Let me fetch the Keycloak 26.1.2 message bundles directly from the upstream source:

reasoning_content: Let's try a different approach: download the keycloak messages from the GitHub source for version 26.1.2. The en/de properties files are in the keycloak repository under `themes/src/main/resources/theme/base/messages/`. We can fetch messages.properties and messages_de.properties for tag 26.1.2.

tool_call.name: terminal
tool_call.arguments:
{"command": "mkdir -p /tmp/kc-msg && cd /tmp/kc-msg
for f in messages messages_de; do
  curl -fsSL "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/keycloak/keycloak/26.1.2/themes/src/main/resources/theme/base/messages/$f.properties" -o "$f.properties" && echo "OK $f $(wc -l < $f.properties)" || echo "FAIL $f"
done
echo "=== en special/length keys ==="
grep -iE "specialchar|invalidPasswordLength|lowerCase|upperCase|digit" messages.properties | head
echo "=== de existing ==="
grep -iE "specialchar|invalidPasswordLength|lowerCase|upperCase|digit" messages_de.properties | head", "description": "Download keycloak message bundles from GitHub", "security_risk": "MEDIUM", "summary": "Download keycloak 26.1.2 message bundles"}
